   → the default assigned to SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE in the Makefile equals sandbox.BaseImageRepo, and the default of SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE equals sandbox.OverlayImageRepo; the workflow contains BaseImageRepo as a whole token, OverlayImageRepo as a whole token, and sandbox/images/Containerfile
   Check: unit
   - setup: the consistency test reads Makefile and .github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml
   - setup: repository names are matched as whole tokens: a match must be followed by a character outside [A-Za-z0-9_.-], because BaseImageRepo is a prefix of OverlayImageRepo
   ```
   mk = read('Makefile'); assert defaultOf(mk,'SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE') == BaseImageRepo && defaultOf(mk,'SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE') == OverlayImageRepo
   wf = read('.github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml')
   assert hasToken(wf, BaseImageRepo) && hasToken(wf, OverlayImageRepo) && contains(wf, 'sandbox/images/Containerfile')
   ```
1. [REQ-8.3] IF the Containerfile, the Makefile or the release workflow differs from the constants or the stage layout the consistency test asserts, THEN THE consistency test SHALL fail without needing a container engine
   → the test fails with a message naming the file and the expected value
   Check: unit
   - setup: the Containerfile, Makefile and workflow checks are pure functions over file text that return their findings, called here with in-memory copies of the real files
   - setup: no container engine is invoked
   ```
   assert checkContainerfile(cf, mod) == [] && checkMakefile(mk) == [] && checkWorkflow(wf) == []
   f = checkContainerfile(replace(cf,'FROM scratch','FROM debian:trixie-slim'), mod); assert any(f, has('sandbox/images/Containerfile') && has('FROM scratch'))
   f = checkMakefile(setDefault(mk,'SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE','ghcr.io/other/x')); assert any(f, has('Makefile') && has(OverlayImageRepo))
   f = checkWorkflow(removeToken(wf, BaseImageRepo)); assert any(f, has('.github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml') && has(BaseImageRepo))
   ```
1. [REQ-8.4] THE make check SHALL run the buildver, image-reference and consistency tests while building no image and invoking no container engine
   → make check exits 0 on a host with neither podman nor docker on PATH, and TS-09-20 passes
   Check: integration
   - setup: the go toolchain; the test skips under -short and when AGENTKIT_IMGTEST_NESTED is set
   - setup: stub directory A whose podman and docker stubs append their argv to a marker file and exit 1, prepended to PATH
   - setup: AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE, AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE, AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION and AGENTKIT_CONTAINER removed from the subprocess environment
   ```
   if testing.Short() || getenv('AGENTKIT_IMGTEST_NESTED') != '': skip
   env = without(os.Environ(), AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_*, 'AGENTKIT_CONTAINER') + {PATH: A+':'+PATH, AGENTKIT_IMGTEST_NESTED:'1'}
   out, code = goTest('-count=1','./sandbox/internal/buildver/','./sandbox/','./sandbox/images/', env)
   assert code == 0 && !exists(marker)
   ```
1. [REQ-8.5] THE sandbox/images package SHALL hold only _test.go files, so that internal/policy's cross-target gate (cgo off, four targets) and host-cgo gate build and vet it
   → TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet and TestHostCgoBuildAndVet pass
   Check: integration
   - setup: the go toolchain; the gate run is skipped under -short, as the gates themselves are
   ```
   g, c, t, x = goList('./sandbox/images/'); assert g == 0 && c == 0 && t + x >= 1
   out, code = goTest('-count=1','-v','-run','TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet|TestHostCgoBuildAndVet','./internal/policy/'); assert code == 0 && passed(out,'TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet') && passed(out,'TestHostCgoBuildAndVet')
   ```
1. [REQ-8.6] THE repository SHALL add no require directive to any go.mod, leave the exported API of the packages agentkit, core, tools and codemode unchanged, and stay within TS-12-14's line budgets
   → the direct-dependency allowlist test and TS-12-14 pass
   Check: integration
   - setup: the go toolchain
   ```
   assert goTest('-run','TestRemovedDependenciesPruned_TS09_15|TestDirectDependenciesAreApproved_TS09_16','./internal/policy/').code == 0
   assert goTest('-run','TestLineBudgets_TS12_14','./core/').code == 0
   for m in goListDepsModules('./sandbox/images/','./sandbox/internal/buildver/'): assert m == 'github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go' || m in approvedAllowlist
   ```

### REQ-9: The release workflow's images job

**Rationale:** A tag push publishes both multi-arch images only after the image tests pass on the runner, and a dispatch run is a dry run that never pushes.

#### Criteria

1. [REQ-9.1] THE release workflow SHALL trigger on push of tags matching `v*` and on workflow_dispatch; declare top-level `permissions: contents: read`, with only the publishing job adding `packages: write`; and group concurrency per ref with `cancel-in-progress: false`
   → on: has push with tags containing v* and has workflow_dispatch; top-level permissions has exactly contents: read; `packages: write` occurs exactly once, inside the images job; the verify job adds no packages permission; concurrency has a group expression containing github.ref and cancel-in-progress: false; every uses: value matches ^(actions/checkout|actions/setup-go|docker/setup-qemu-action|docker/setup-buildx-action|docker/login-action)@v[0-9]+$, and docker/metadata-action does not occur
   Check: unit
   - setup: sandbox/images/workflow_test.go reads .github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml with a line-oriented reader in the test (indentation-based keys, steps, literal run blocks), with no YAML dependency
   ```
   wf = parseWorkflow(read('.github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml'))
   assert 'v*' in wf.on.push.tags && wf.on.has('workflow_dispatch')
   assert wf.permissions == {contents:'read'} && countLines(wf,'packages: write') == 1 && wf.jobs.images.permissions.packages == 'write' && 'packages' not in wf.jobs.verify.permissions
   assert has(wf.concurrency.group,'github.ref') && wf.concurrency['cancel-in-progress'] == 'false'
   for u in usesLines(wf): assert match('^(actions/checkout|actions/setup-go|docker/setup-qemu-action|docker/setup-buildx-action|docker/login-action)@v[0-9]+$', u)
   assert !has(raw,'docker/metadata-action')
   ```
1. [REQ-9.2] IF on a tag push, GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match `^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$`, THEN THE images job SHALL fail before building or publishing
   → the version step exits non-zero with a message naming the ref, and no image is pushed
   Check: integration
   - setup: bash on PATH, else the test skips
   - setup: the run block of the images job's step with `id: version`, extracted by the workflow reader; it contains no `${{` and reads only environment variables
   ```
   s = step(wf.jobs.images, id='version'); assert !has(s.run,'${{')
   for ref in ['v1.2','1.2.3','v01.2.3','v1.02.3','v1.2.3+build','v1.2.3-','v1.2.3-rc_1','main']:
     out, code, gout = bash(s.run, env{GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:'push', GITHUB_REF_TYPE:'tag', GITHUB_REF:'refs/tags/'+ref, GITHUB_REF_NAME:ref, GITHUB_OUTPUT:tmp})
     assert code != 0 && has(out, ref) && outputs(gout).get('tags','') == ''
   assert idx(s) < min(idx of build/login/push steps) && no 'continue-on-error' in wf
   ```
1. [REQ-9.3] THE images job SHALL for any ref name that matches the version pattern, set the version to the ref name and the image tags to the version without its `v`, plus MAJOR.MINOR when the version has no prerelease part
   → v1.2.3 yields the tags 1.2.3 and 1.2; v1.2.3-rc.1 yields only 1.2.3-rc.1
   Check: property
   - setup: bash on PATH, else the test skips; the version step's run block as in TS-16-31
   - setup: math/rand/v2 with a fixed seed and 300 iterations; the step writes version= and space-separated tags= lines to $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   ```
   for ref in fixed + [gen(r) for _ in 0..300]:
     code, o = bash(s.run, env{GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:'push', GITHUB_REF_TYPE:'tag', GITHUB_REF_NAME:ref, GITHUB_OUTPUT:tmp})
     want = {ref[1:]} | ({maj+'.'+min} if '-' not in ref else {})
     assert code == 0 && o.version == ref && set(split(o.tags)) == want
   ```
1. [REQ-9.4] WHEN the images job runs on ubuntu-24.04, THE images job SHALL check out the repository, set up Go with `go-version-file: go.mod`, and run `make sandbox-images-test CONTAINER=docker SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG=ci AGENTKIT_VERSION=<version> AGENTKIT_REVISION=$GITHUB_SHA`. This runs with the runner's default docker builder, before any QEMU or buildx setup step
   → the test step appears before every setup-qemu, setup-buildx, login and push step in the job
   Check: unit
   - setup: the images job's steps from the workflow reader
   ```
   j = wf.jobs.images; assert j['runs-on'] == 'ubuntu-24.04'
   assert idx(uses(j,'actions/checkout')) < idx(uses(j,'actions/setup-go')) && uses(j,'actions/setup-go').with['go-version-file'] == 'go.mod'
   t = stepRunning(j,'make sandbox-images-test'); assert has(t.run,'CONTAINER=docker') && has(t.run,'SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG=ci') && refsVersionOutput(t) && refsGitHubSHA(t) && t.if == none
   for s in steps(j) if s.uses in [setup-qemu, setup-buildx, login] or has(s.run,'--push'): assert idx(t) < idx(s) && !matches(s.if,'always\(\)|failure\(\)|cancelled\(\)')
   assert no step has 'continue-on-error'
   ```
1. [REQ-9.5] IF the test step fails, THEN THE images job SHALL end the job without publishing
   → the job fails, and no login or push step runs
   Check: same as REQ-9.4
1. [REQ-9.6] WHEN the run was triggered by a tag push and the test step passed, THE images job SHALL set up QEMU and buildx, log in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, and run `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --push` once with `--target base` and once with `--target overlay`. Both builds take the same build arguments and every computed tag on their own repository
   → both repositories carry each computed tag as a manifest list for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64
   Check: integration
   - setup: bash on PATH, else the test skips
   - setup: the images job's publish steps from the workflow reader; the push run block contains no `${{` and reads the version and tags from environment variables declared in its env: block
   - setup: a fake docker first on PATH that appends each invocation's argv to a log and exits 0
   ```
   j = wf.jobs.images; l = uses(j,'docker/login-action'); assert l.with.registry == 'ghcr.io' && has(l.with.username,'github.actor') && has(l.with.password,'secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN')
   assert idx(uses(j,'docker/setup-qemu-action')) < idx(l) && idx(uses(j,'docker/setup-buildx-action')) < idx(l) < idx(pushStep)
   assert !has(pushStep.run,'${{'); log = bashWithFakeDocker(pushStep.run, envFor(pushStep, version='v1.2.3', tags='1.2.3 1.2'), GITHUB_SHA='abc')
   b = [a for a in log if a[0:2] == ['buildx','build']]; assert len(b) == 2
   for a in b: assert flag(a,'--platform') == 'linux/amd64,linux/arm64' && flag(a,'-f') == 'sandbox/images/Containerfile' && '--push' in a && buildArgs(a) == {AGENTKIT_VERSION:'v1.2.3', AGENTKIT_REVISION:'abc'}
   assert tags(target(b,'base')) == {BaseImageRepo+':1.2.3', BaseImageRepo+':1.2'} && tags(target(b,'overlay')) == {OverlayImageRepo+':1.2.3', OverlayImageRepo+':1.2'}
   ```
1. [REQ-9.7] WHILE the run was triggered by workflow_dispatch, THE release workflow SHALL build and test with an empty version, compute no publishing tags, never log in, never push, and skip the verify job
   → every login and push step and the verify job are conditioned on a tag push
   Check: integration
   - setup: bash on PATH, else the test skips; the version step's run block as in TS-16-31
   - setup: the steps and job conditions from the workflow reader
   ```
   for (type, name) in [('branch','main'), ('tag','v1.2.3')]:
     code, o = bash(s.run, env{GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:'workflow_dispatch', GITHUB_REF_TYPE:type, GITHUB_REF_NAME:name, GITHUB_OUTPUT:tmp}); assert code == 0 && o.version == '' && o.tags == ''
   for st in publishSteps(wf.jobs.images): assert requiresTagPush(st.if)
   assert requiresTagPush(wf.jobs.verify.if) && !requiresTagPush(testStep.if)
   ```
1. [REQ-9.8] THE release workflow SHALL use only actions/checkout, actions/setup-go, docker/setup-qemu-action, docker/setup-buildx-action and docker/login-action, each pinned to a major version tag, and compute tags in shell rather than with a third-party action
   → every `uses:` line names one of those five actions followed by `@v<major>`
   Check: same as REQ-9.1

### REQ-10: The release workflow's verify job

**Rationale:** A package that only maintainers can pull has not been published for embedders, so each release is proven by an anonymous pull on every platform (DD 17).

#### Criteria

1. [REQ-10.1] WHEN the run was triggered by a tag push and the images job succeeded, THE verify job SHALL set up QEMU without logging in to any registry and, for each repository, computed tag and platform in {linux/amd64, linux/arm64}, run `docker pull --platform <platform> <reference>`
   → the job declares `needs: images`, has no login step, and pulls every repository, tag and platform combination
   Check: integration
   - setup: bash on PATH, else the test skips
   - setup: the verify job from the workflow reader; its run block contains no `${{` and reads the version and tags from environment variables mapped in its env: from needs.images.outputs
   - setup: a fake docker first on PATH that logs each argv, exits 0 for pull, and prints `agentkit-sandboxd v1.2.3 (protocol 1.0)` for run
   ```
   v = wf.jobs.verify; assert v.needs in ['images', ['images']] && uses(v,'docker/setup-qemu-action') && !uses(v,'docker/login-action') && !has(runs(v),'docker login')
   log, code = bashWithFakeDocker(v.run, envFor(v, version='v1.2.3', tags='1.2.3 1.2')); assert code == 0
   combos = {(r,t,p) for r in [BaseImageRepo, OverlayImageRepo] for t in ['1.2.3','1.2'] for p in ['linux/amd64','linux/arm64']}
   assert {(ref(a),platform(a)) for a in pulls(log)} == {(r+':'+t, p) for (r,t,p) in combos}
   for a in runs(log): assert '--rm' in a && flag(a,'--entrypoint') == '/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd' && a[-1] == '--version'; assert len(runs(log)) == 8
   ```
1. [REQ-10.2] WHEN the verify job has pulled a reference, THE verify job SHALL run it with `--entrypoint /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd` and the argument `--version`
   → the output starts with `agentkit-sandboxd <version> ` for every repository, tag and platform
   Check: same as REQ-10.1
1. [REQ-10.3] IF an anonymous pull fails, as it does while a GHCR package is still private, or the --version output lacks the expected prefix, THEN THE verify job SHALL fail without touching the images already published
   → the job exits non-zero naming the reference, and it can be re-run alone without re-running the images job
   Check: integration
   - setup: bash on PATH, else the test skips; the verify job's run block and env mapping as in TS-16-36, with version v1.2.3 and tags "1.2.3 1.2"
   - setup: a fake docker on PATH that logs each argv and is scripted per case
   ```
   for case in [pullFails(OverlayImageRepo+':1.2','linux/arm64'), runPrints('agentkit-sandboxd v1.2.2 (protocol 1.0)'), runPrints('agentkit-sandboxd v1.2.30 (protocol 1.0)')]:
     log, code, out = bashWithFakeDocker(v.run, env, case)
     assert code != 0 && has(out, case.failingRef)
     assert no a in log with a[0] in ['push','tag','rmi','login','buildx']
   assert inputsOnlyFrom(v, 'needs.images.outputs') && !uses(v,'actions/download-artifact')
   ```

## Execution Paths

### PATH-1: A developer builds the images and tests the base image locally

1. **developer** runs `make sandbox-images-test AGENTKIT_VERSION=v0.6.0` on a Linux or macOS host with podman or docker
2. **Makefile** resolves CONTAINER and runs `build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target base` and then `--target overlay`, passing AGENTKIT_VERSION and AGENTKIT_REVISION and tagging both :dev references
3. **Containerfile build stages** download modules, compile agentkit-sandboxd with cgo and statically with `-X …buildver.stamp=v0.6.0`, and assemble the base and overlay images
4. **Makefile** runs `go test -count=1 -v ./sandbox/images/` with the AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_* variables and AGENTKIT_CONTAINER set
5. **harness** runs `run --rm -i --network none --entrypoint <AgentPath> <base> <AgentArgs(spec)…>`, wraps the pipes with stdioconn.New and attaches with attach.Dial
6. **agentkit-sandboxd** applies its Landlock ruleset and answers Hello with Version v0.6.0, Workdir /workspace, OutlineBackend tree-sitter and Git true
7. **image tests** call Tools, which passes the digest check, and run proxy execute and write_file probes as uid 1000 inside /workspace
8. **harness** closes the sandbox and removes the container; go test reports PASS and make exits 0

**Smoke check — real components (must not be mocked):** Makefile sandbox-images and sandbox-images-test targets, sandbox/images/Containerfile and .dockerignore, podman or docker, golang:1.27-trixie and debian:trixie-slim, agentkit-sandboxd, cgo and static builds with the buildver stamp, the sandbox/images harness, stdioconn.New and attach.Dial, the proxy execute and write_file tools

**Setup:**

- a Linux or macOS host with podman or docker and network access to pull debian:trixie-slim and golang:1.27-trixie
- a checkout of the repository

**End state:**

- make exits 0, and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:latest and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:latest both exist in the engine's image store
- the go test output reports PASS, not SKIP, for the base image test, whose agent answered Hello with Version v0.6.0, Workdir /workspace, OutlineBackend tree-sitter and Git true, and whose Tools call and proxy execute and write_file probes succeeded
- `run --rm --entrypoint /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd <image> --version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd v0.6.0 (protocol M.N)` for both :dev images
- `ps -a` lists no container named agentkit-imgtest-*

### PATH-2: An embedder adds the agent to its own image with the overlay COPY line

1. **embedder** calls sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay ref>) and writes a Containerfile of `FROM <base ref>` followed by that line into a temporary context
2. **container engine** builds the derived image, copying the static agent from the overlay image to /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd
3. **harness** starts the derived image with `--entrypoint <AgentPath>` and sandbox.AgentArgs(spec), and attaches with attach.Dial
4. **copied agent** answers Hello with OutlineBackend none and the expected version
5. **image tests** call Tools, which passes the digest check, and run proxy execute of `echo ok`, which exits 0
6. **harness** closes the sandbox and removes the container and the derived image

**Smoke check — real components (must not be mocked):** sandbox.OverlayCopyLine, podman or docker building from the local base and overlay images, the static agentkit-sandboxd copied from the overlay image, the sandbox/images harness, stdioconn.New and attach.Dial, the proxy execute tool

**Setup:**

- the images from TS-16-51 and the same make sandbox-images-test run, with both image variables set

**End state:**

- the go test output reports PASS, not SKIP, for the derived-image part
- the copied agent answered Hello with OutlineBackend none and Version v0.6.0, Tools passed the digest check, and echo ok exited 0
- after the test, the derived image reference is absent from `$CONTAINER images` and no agentkit-imgtest-* container remains

### PATH-3: A maintainer publishes a release by pushing a version tag

1. **maintainer** pushes the git tag vX.Y.Z to github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
2. **images job** validates GITHUB_REF_NAME against the version pattern and computes the tags X.Y.Z and X.Y
3. **images job** runs `make sandbox-images-test CONTAINER=docker SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG=ci AGENTKIT_VERSION=vX.Y.Z AGENTKIT_REVISION=$GITHUB_SHA` on the default docker builder, and the tests pass
4. **images job** sets up QEMU and buildx, logs in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, and pushes both targets for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 with every computed tag
5. **verify job** pulls each repository, tag and platform anonymously and runs `--version`, which prints `agentkit-sandboxd vX.Y.Z (protocol M.N)`

**Smoke check — real components (must not be mocked):** GitHub Actions on ubuntu-24.04, .github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml images and verify jobs, make sandbox-images-test with docker's default builder, docker buildx with QEMU, ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN and anonymous pulls, sandbox/images/Containerfile

**Setup:**

- the release workflow on the default branch of github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
- both GHCR packages public (on the first release, made public after the first verify run fails, then verify re-run alone)

**End state:**

- the images job's test step passed on the default docker builder before the QEMU, buildx, login and push steps ran, and the job succeeded
- `docker buildx imagetools inspect` of quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd at X.Y.Z and X.Y lists linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, the arm64 cgo agent having been cross-compiled on the amd64 runner
- the verify job succeeded without logging in, and an anonymous `docker pull --platform linux/arm64` of each tag followed by `--entrypoint /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd … --version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd vX.Y.Z (protocol M.N)`

### PATH-4: An embedder's binary resolves the default image for its agentkit-go version

1. **embedder binary** built against agentkit-go at a release version, or stamped with `-X …buildver.stamp=vX.Y.Z`, calls sandbox.DefaultImage() and sandbox.OverlayImage()
2. **buildver package** returns the stamp when set, else the agentkit-go module version from build info, else (devel)
3. **sandbox package** passes the version to ImageTag, which accepts a canonical release and refuses (devel), pseudo-versions and build metadata
4. **sandbox package** returns quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:X.Y.Z and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:X.Y.Z, or an error wrapping ErrNoPublishedImage that names the version, Spec.Image and `make sandbox-images`

**Smoke check — real components (must not be mocked):** Go linker -ldflags -X, sandbox/internal/buildver Version, sandbox.ImageTag, DefaultImage and OverlayImage, sandbox/testdata/imageref embedder program

**Setup:**

- the go toolchain; the test skips under -short
- sandbox/testdata/imageref/main.go, which prints DefaultImage() and OverlayImage() on two lines and exits 0, or prints the error to stderr and exits 1

**End state:**

- the v1.2.3 binary exits 0 and prints quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:1.2.3 then quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:1.2.3
- the unstamped binary exits 1 and its stderr contains "sandbox: no published image for this agentkit-go version", "(devel)", "Spec.Image" and "make sandbox-images"
- the pseudo-version binary exits 1 and its stderr contains the same error text and v1.2.4-0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef


# Tasks

## Test Commands

- **all_tests:** `make test`
- **linter:** `make lint`
- **spec_tests:** `go test -count=1 ./sandbox/... ./internal/policy/`

## Dependencies

- `13_sandbox_core` — The images package sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd at sandbox.AgentPath; the tests use attach.Dial and attach.Config, stdioconn.New, AgentInfo (Version, Workdir, OutlineBackend, Git), ProtocolMajor/ProtocolMinor, ErrToolMismatch and the Tools digest check, and the --version line. This spec adds buildver.stamp to 13's sandbox/internal/buildver, adds sandbox/image.go to package sandbox, and extends 13's README, architecture, configuration and CLI docs.
- `14_sandbox_rsync_sync` — The agent carries the rsync protocol itself, so the base image ships no rsync binary and TS-16-39 asserts its absence; the root-owned agent follows 14's trust model.
- `15_sandbox_landlock_agent` — The base image's cgo build links psx's cgo variant through go-landlock, which must link with no CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW; the harness starts the agent with sandbox.AgentArgs; the image layout matches 15's writable and read-only roots; the Landlock check reads AgentInfo.Landlock (ABI, Note); 15 bumped the protocol to 1.2, which the --version assertions format from the constants.
- `09_repository_cut` — The test-only package sandbox/images must pass internal/policy's TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet and TestHostCgoBuildAndVet, TS-09-15/TS-09-16 must stay green with no new require, and TS-09-20 (make check) must stay green and offline.
- `12_core_schema_guard` — TS-12-14's line budget in core/size_test.go counts the production lines sandbox/image.go and the buildver change add; TS-16-29 runs it.
